measures.title: Orangeburg County one percent local option sales and use tax
measures.summary: Would levy a one percent local option sales and use tax in Orangeburg County. The revenue would be used to give a credit against taxpayers' county and municipal property tax bills and to fund county and municipal operations in the Orangeburg County area.
measures.yesMeans: A one percent sales and use tax would be levied in Orangeburg County to reduce county and municipal property taxes and fund local government operations.
measures.noMeans: The local option sales and use tax would not be levied.
